svg.desc: Consultancy Services for Special Emergency Forces LOCATION Madinah - Riyadh - Asir - Makkah, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia CLIENT Special Emergency Forces STATUS EST. VALUE In Progress N/A DISCIPLINES Urban Planning & Design Mechanical Engineering Structural / Civil Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview Provision of Engineering Consultancy Services for Studies and Designs of High-Priority Construction and Renovation Projects for the Special Emergency Forces. BECT's scope included project management, site supervision, conceptual design, detailed drawings and tender documents. The multidisciplinary services covered urban planning & design, mechanical engineering, structural / civil engineering and electrical engineering.
